purpose: Represent advancement of an ongoing task.
avoid: Unknown duration needs a distinct indeterminate state.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: Meaningful dynamic content/container; no user-set value on the root. Actual native scroll or delegated disclosure/action behavior remains explicitly described and exercised, rather than being classified as decorative.
contentAlternative: ProgressLabel registers the task name; Root reports min/max/value/value text. ProgressValue visible text is aria-hidden because Root conveys it. Caller supplies explicit failure and completion messages outside the progressbar; color and width are supplementary.
updatesAndDescendants: Root value is required number|null; null or nonfinite is indeterminate with no aria-valuenow. Finite values are clamped to min/max, normalized for indicator width, formatted by locale/format, and complete when clamped value equals max. getAriaValueText(formattedValue,rawValue) or aria-valuetext supplies meaningful units. This reference requires finite min<max. The wrapper always inserts Track/Indicator after children; passing another Track in children duplicates the track. There is no timer, request, cancellation or onValueChange. The caller updates props and announces task completion/error separately.
referenceDecision: The upload task, finite increasing bounds precondition, textual completion/error feedback and localized units are explicit caller policies. This informative progress display has no user-adjustable value or slider keyboard protocol.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: The pinned Progress root adds exactly one Track/Indicator after caller children; callers should not add a duplicate default track. Visible native track height is4px inside a12px artwork frame, confirmed by the separate deep native read. The source root gap 12px and native full corner are semantic metrics; sample 384px width and 240px range are observations, never runtime dimensions. The primitive owns clamping, localized value, aria-valuenow/valuetext and inline indicator percentage across min/max; CSS preserves that inline width and logical start in RTL. Indeterminate state has no numeric value: this reference uses a static centered 35% segment plus the real indeterminate description, without inventing a measured animation timing. The caller provides separate completion/error feedback; progress itself is passive and has no disabled or keyboard-action API.
